message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a hearty homemade lasagna (serves ~8–10 people):

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount |
|----------|------------|----------------|
| **Lasagna sheets** | Fresh or dried pasta noodles | 9‑12 sheets (or one box of no-boil if preferred) |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (80/20 lean/fat mix) | 1 lb (≈450 g) |
| | Optional ground pork or Italian sausage | ½ lb (optional) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 small onion |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 garlic cloves |
| | Crushed tomatoes / tomato passata | 28 oz (800 ml) canned |
| | Tomato paste | 2 tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1–2 tsp |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste |
| | Dried oregano, basil, thyme | 1 tsp each |
| | Red wine (optional) | ¼ cup |
| | Sugar (if acidity needs balancing) | Pinch |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large egg |
| | Grated Parmesan | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| | Chopped fresh parsley or basil | 2 tbsp |
| | Nutmeg (freshly grated, optional) | pinch |
| | Salt & pepper | To taste |
| **Bechamel sauce** *(traditional)* | Butter | 4 Tbsp (60 g) |
| | All-purpose flour | ⅓ cup (40 g) |
| | Milk (whole milk works best) | 3 cups (720 ml) |
| | Salt, nutmeg, white pepper | To taste |
| **Cheese topping** | Shredded mozzarella | 2–3 cups (225 g) |
| | Extra shredded Parmesan | ½ cup (50 g) |

### Quick “no-bake” version:
If you’re short on time or don’t want to pre-cook the noodles:

* Use a boxed no‑boil lasagna sheet set instead of boiling regular ones.
* Skip the béchamel; just layer ricotta mixture over meat sauce.

Feel free to tweak quantities based on your appetite—more veggies like spinach or zucchini work great too!
